title: Tomato pasta in 15 minutes, for 2 euros

lines.say: Tomato pasta. Fifteen minutes, two euros.
Warm garlic in olive oil, then crush in the tomatoes.
lines.cap: Warm *garlic* in olive oil, then crush in *the tomatoes.*

lines.say: Let it bubble while the pasta cooks.
lines.cap: Let it *bubble* while the pasta cooks.

lines.say: Toss it together, add basil. Dinner for two!
lines.cap: Toss it together, add *basil.* *Dinner for two!*
